title: Translate partner-priority pack set into agreed language(s)/locale
context: With a partner secured, the partner-priority scenario pack set is translated into the agreed language(s) for the agreed locale through the full reviewed, licensed pipeline. This is the body of work that becomes the field-delivered set. It depends on the partner agreement, extended glossary, and pronunciation support.
objective: Translate the partner-priority pack set into the agreed language(s)/locale as complete, reviewed, licensed packs.
acceptanceCriteria: License clearance confirmed for all items before drafting; agreed locale emergency number verified and injected
Partner-priority scenario pack set translated in full into the agreed language(s), UTF-8; preserved tokens exact; register/gender per glossary; pronunciation/transliteration included
Each pack ships provenance.yaml and attribution.txt (attribution + mandatory disclaimer verbatim in target and pivot language)
Qualified-speaker sign-offs recorded in PR, independent of drafting; Tier B/C second reviewer; every Tier-C phrase back-translated; medical-critical Tier-C clinician sign-off
License/attribution check green; all agentFlags resolved before sign-off
outputLicense: Source-compatible: CC-BY-SA-4.0 for project-original phrases; source-mandated license + mandatory disclaimer where derived (e.g. WHO CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO) — never relicensed as a more permissive license
